'''Zarrak''' was a powerful shaman in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology, known for stealing fire from the sun and giving it to the Ewoks. "Zarrak" was a popular name for male [[Wokling/Legends|Ewok children]],<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Zarrak|the magic-wielding Ewok]] who was once [[Logray/Legends|Logray's]] apprentice.<ref name="Ewoks TFA">{{Ewoks|The First Apprentice}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Zarrak was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
